SELECT s.*, h.code hu, a.name article, a.sku, a.type, COALESCE(rc.name, a.type) typeName, COALESCE(c.name, 'Fără categorie') category,
  e.code ewc, g.code org, pt.name point, p.name partner, o.number order_no, op.number opening_no, ro.number res_order_no,
  rt.number res_treat_no, io.number in_op_no, tp.number op_no
  FROM stock s JOIN articles a ON a.id = s.article_id LEFT JOIN hus h ON h.id = s.hu_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = a.category_id
  LEFT JOIN categories rc ON rc.parent_id IS NULL AND rc.root = a.type LEFT JOIN ewc e ON e.id = s.ewc_id LEFT JOIN orgs g ON g.id = s.org_id
  LEFT JOIN points pt ON pt.id = s.point_id LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id = s.partner_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = s.order_id
  LEFT JOIN openings op ON op.id = s.opening_id LEFT JOIN orders ro ON ro.id = s.res_order_id
  LEFT JOIN treat_orders rt ON rt.id = s.res_treat_id LEFT JOIN treat_ops io ON io.id = s.in_op_id LEFT JOIN treat_ops tp ON tp.id = s.treat_op_id

SELECT s.hu_id, h.code hu, a.sku, a.name article, c.name category, e.code ewc, s.lot, s.kg, s.stock_date date, pt.name point,
    CASE WHEN s.source = 'stoc_initial' THEN 'Stoc inițial' WHEN s.source = 'tratare' THEN (SELECT number FROM treat_ops WHERE id = s.treat_op_id) ELSE COALESCE(p.name, '') END origin,
    COALESCE((SELECT created_by FROM reception_items WHERE id = s.item_id), (SELECT created_by FROM openings WHERE id = s.opening_id), (SELECT created_by FROM treat_ops WHERE id = s.treat_op_id), '') operator
    FROM stock s JOIN hus h ON h.id = s.hu_id JOIN articles a ON a.id = s.article_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN ewc e ON e.id = s.ewc_id
    LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id = s.partner_id LEFT JOIN points pt ON pt.id = s.point_id
    WHERE s.hu_id IN ({0}) AND s.status IN ({1}) ORDER BY s.id

SELECT o.*, ss.day, t.number trt,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(kg), 0) FROM treat_inputs WHERE op_id = o.id) in_kg, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(kg), 0) FROM treat_outputs WHERE op_id = o.id) out_kg,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM treat_inputs WHERE op_id = o.id) n_in, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM treat_outputs WHERE op_id = o.id) n_out
  FROM treat_ops o JOIN treat_sessions ss ON ss.id = o.session_id LEFT JOIN treat_orders t ON t.id = o.treat_order_id

SELECT s.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM treat_ops o WHERE o.session_id = s.id AND o.status = 'deschisa') open_ops
    FROM treat_sessions s WHERE s.point_id = ? AND s.status = 'deschisa' AND s.day < ? ORDER BY s.day

SELECT t.*,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(kg), 0) FROM stock s WHERE s.res_treat_id = t.id AND s.status = 'rezervat_tratare') reserved_kg,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE('h' || s.hu_id, 's' || s.id)) FROM stock s WHERE s.res_treat_id = t.id AND s.status = 'rezervat_tratare') reserved_n,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.kg), 0) FROM treat_inputs i JOIN treat_ops o ON o.id = i.op_id WHERE o.treat_order_id = t.id AND o.status <> 'anulata') treated_kg,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM treat_ops o WHERE o.treat_order_id = t.id AND o.status <> 'anulata') ops,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM treat_ops o WHERE o.treat_order_id = t.id AND o.status = 'deschisa') open_ops
  FROM treat_orders t

SELECT x.hu_id, h.code hu, a.sku, a.name article, c.name category, e.code ewc, x.lot, x.kg, ? date, ? point, ? origin, x.created_by operator
    FROM treat_outputs x JOIN hus h ON h.id = x.hu_id JOIN articles a ON a.id = x.article_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN ewc e ON e.id = x.ewc_id
    WHERE x.op_id = ? ORDER BY x.id
